The Suites

Built for the longstay.

The 501 is an eight-storey purpose-built rental at 1521 Queen Street West, designed as a rental from the first drawing. Suites are planned for long-term living: full-size bedrooms, generous storage, and two-bathroom layouts in the family plans.

One institutional owner. One professional manager. Residents lease directly from the company that maintains the building, and a lease here renews for as long as you choose to stay.

Residents

What comes withthe keys.

A resident program arranged with established partners, in place from the day you move in.

City of Toronto Program

Transit, included.

Every new resident at The 501 receives a pre-loaded PRESTO card, value to be confirmed, provided through the City of Toronto's new-resident transit program. The 501 streetcar stops at the corner; King Street, the Financial District and the waterfront are a direct ride.

Pre-Loaded PRESTO Card
Every New Resident

Points on every rent payment.

Pay rent through Chexy with any major credit card and earn Aeroplan points on your largest monthly expense. A typical two-bedroom earns enough for a round-trip flight each year.

Gigabit fibre from day one.

Preferred resident pricing on Bell Fibe gigabit internet, pre-wired to every suite and active the day you collect your keys. No technician window, no setup gap.

Moving day, handled.

Move-In Concierge
